hint_ladder.title: Bigas ng Sari-sari Store
hint_ladder.text: Isipin: 3 kilong bigas na hahatiin sa 8 pamilya. Bawat isa tatanggap ng 3/8 kilo. Convert natin to decimal!

hint_ladder.title: Divide: 3 ÷ 8
hint_ladder.text: 8 goes into 3 zero times, lagyan ng decimal point. 3.0 becomes 30. 8 × 3 = 24, remainder 6. Kaya 0.3 muna.

hint_ladder.title: Tuloy ang Long Division
hint_ladder.text: Bring down 0 to 6 → 60. 8 × 7 = 56, remainder 4. Bring down 0 → 40. 8 × 5 = 40, zero remainder. So 0.375!

hint_ladder.title: Sagot: 0.375 kilo
hint_ladder.text: Bawat pamilya 0.375 kilo ng bigas. Kaya 3/8 = 0.375. Tama!

A.text: You might have chosen A because 0.25 is 1/4 or 2/8, not 3/8—naisip mong hati sa apat?

B.text: You might have chosen B because 0.3 comes from 3/10, not 3/8—ingat sa denominator!

C.text: Correct. 3 divided by 8 equals exactly 0.375—walang labis, walang kulang!

D.text: You might have chosen D because 0.4 is a rounded version of 0.375, pero exact conversion dapat 0.375.

next_time_rule: **Key Takeaway:** Always divide numerator by denominator. For 3/8, 3÷8=0.375. Practice sa jeepney fare splits!
deconstruct_text:
Para ma-convert ang fraction na 3/8 sa decimal, isipin mo ang sari-sari store ni Aling Nena. May 3 kilong bigas, ipapamahagi sa 8 pamilya. Bawat isa 3/8 kilo. I-divide ang 3 sa 8: 3 ÷ 8 = 0.375. Gamit ang long division: 8 sa 3.0 = 0.3 (8×3=24, remainder 6).

**Watch-Out Zone: unit_conversion_trap**—huwag gumamit ng 10 bilang denominator, 0.3 yan!
